mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, we have overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 57 degrees. Please be aware that air quality is currently at a moderate level of 53.

The city has shared a few reminders for residents. Please note that alternate side parking is now in effect until April 1, and the Senior Center will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday.
Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there are several trivia events across the city at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.
In a notable report from October 25, officers arrested a man for an O W I offence after finding him unresponsive in his vehicle at a local intersection.
You can enjoy the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie at Culver's of Verona today. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:00 PM.
